## Call for abstracts and papers {#current-status}

::: {.callout-important}
Applications for the Paper Development Workshop and Expert Workshop use separate Google Forms. Abstracts are due by **14 August 2026**, and applicants will be notified around **31 August 2026**.
:::

The Japan QCA Conference brings together researchers who apply QCA in empirical research and experts working on the latest QCA and related methodological developments. The PDW is held in person at Komatsu Hall, Research Innovation Center (Building 121), Waseda University, Tokyo. The EW is a hybrid event, combining in-person and online participation.

## Choose the right workshop

::: {.link-grid}
::: {.link-card}
### Paper Development Workshop

For researchers who are already applying QCA in an empirical study and want detailed feedback in small roundtable sessions.

Eligible PhD students with no or insufficient travel funding may apply for a travel grant expected not to exceed ¥50,000. Application details will be provided with the abstract decision.

[Review PDW requirements][cfp-pdw] · [Apply via Google Forms ↗](https://forms.gle/yWGnhG6sx83hpv1v8){target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Apply to the PDW using Google Forms in a new tab"}
:::

::: {.link-card}
### Expert Workshop

For experienced QCA researchers presenting or discussing methodological issues related to QCA or a related method.

The EW is hybrid, combining in-person and online participation.

QCA experts may participate without presenting a paper by indicating this in the same Expert Workshop form.

[Review EW requirements][cfp-ew] · [Apply via Google Forms ↗](https://forms.gle/943yCBMq7ypPbKMy5){target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Apply to the Expert Workshop using Google Forms in a new tab"}
:::
:::

## Programme highlights

- Plenary keynote speeches by [**Carsten Schneider**](https://people.ceu.edu/carsten-q_schneider) and [**Peer Fiss**](https://www.peerfiss.com/)
- An expert roundtable on the progress of QCA practices
- Panel sessions on the latest methodological developments in QCA
- Intensive Paper Development Workshop roundtables
- An open-discussion Expert Workshop

[View the provisional programme overview][programme-page]

## Practical information

There is **no conference fee**. The detailed timetable, session assignments, reception instructions, and accessibility guidance will be added as they are confirmed.

Questions may be sent to [jqca2026@gmail.com](mailto:jqca2026@gmail.com).
